metadata.title: Audio Steganography — Gemini Veo promotional video (real screenshots)
metadata.targetTool: Google Gemini — Create Video (Veo 3.1 / Veo 3.1 Fast)
notes: Use image-to-video mode per scene with the listed referenceImagePath from screenshotsReal/en.
Screenshots are 1080×1920 portrait — place inside floating phone mockup for 16:9 output.
All voiceover and on-screen copy are English only.
Scenes 1–2 may show Persian UI labels from splash/language screens; motion graphics overlay stays English.
Stitch clips in sceneNumber order; total runtime ~54 seconds.
Scene 9 voiceover includes Myket CTA — add Myket URL end card in post (no Myket banner in screenshot set).

veoConfig.negativePrompt: blurry text, garbled UI, watermark, low quality, shaky camera, cartoonish style, outdated 2010 UI, stock photo people, cluttered layout, wrong app screenshots, misspelled words, distorted waveform, fake metric numbers

visualStyle.mood: premium tech, trustworthy, cinematic and clean

colorPalette.background: deep slate gradient with soft teal glow matching app screenshots

visualStyle.motion: smooth Ken Burns on screenshots, subtle parallax, micro-interactions, no harsh cuts
visualStyle.typographyOnScreen: English labels only on motion graphics; crisp sans-serif
visualStyle.deviceFrame: modern bezel-less Android phone mockup at slight 3D angle; portrait screenshot centered in 16:9 frame

referenceImages.usage: Scene 1 — splash intro with waveform and app branding
Scene 2 — Quick guide: LSB + logistic chaos overview
Scene 3 — Embed tab: secret message + live audio recording
Scene 4 — File saved, waveform comparison, SNR/PSNR metrics
Scene 5 — Extract tab: pick stego audio file
Scene 6 — Full guide modal: embed steps and bit-length reminder
Scene 7 — Settings: language, theme color, logistic r/x0 chaos params
Scene 8 — Language picker: Persian, English, Arabic, French
Scene 9 — About: thesis, supervisor, GitHub links, outro

fullScenario: 54-second promo from real app screenshots: splash → LSB chaos intro → embed message and record → quality metrics → extract stego file → save bit length guide → on-device settings and chaos key → four languages → thesis outro and Myket download.

scenes.title: Hook — sound hides secrets
scenes.screenshotContent: Dark splash: Audio Signal branding, glowing teal waveform, steganography tagline, version badge.
scenes.veoPrompt: Cinematic 16:9 tech promo 2026. Image-to-video from provided portrait splash screenshot inside floating bezel-less phone mockup. Slow Ken Burns zoom-in on central waveform icon. Abstract teal audio particles rise from the glowing waveform line and dissolve into subtle binary bits. Dark teal-to-black gradient background from screenshot preserved. Premium research-app aesthetic. Keep UI text sharp — do not rewrite Persian labels. Smooth motion, shallow depth of field.
scenes.voiceover: Your message hides inside the sound wave.

scenes.title: Quick guide — LSB and chaos key
scenes.screenshotContent: Light Quick guide screen: LSB + logistic chaos map thesis research, Embed/Extract/Settings/About cards, Get started button.
scenes.veoPrompt: Image-to-video from provided Quick guide screenshot on floating phone. Light mint-green theme. Sequential highlight glow on four feature rows: Embed shield, Extract magnifier, Settings gear, About people. Subtle scroll-down motion revealing LSB and logistic chaos map intro paragraph. Camera slow push-in. Material 3 clean UI — keep English text readable. 2026 product demo look, 16:9 with phone centered.
scenes.voiceover: Audio Steganography — hide text in audio with LSB and a logistic chaos key.

scenes.title: Embed — type message and record
scenes.screenshotContent: Embed tab: secret message field with sample text, 144 bits counter, live recording at 00:04, audio level bars at 90%, Stop Recording.
scenes.veoPrompt: Image-to-video using provided Embed screen screenshot. Simulate typing cursor in message field, then pulsing red record button and animated audio level bars climbing. Timer ticks subtly. Floating phone mockup, light theme, teal accents. Keep bit counter and Audio Steganography header sharp. Modern Android demo 2026, 16:9.
scenes.voiceover: Type your text, then record audio or upload a WAV or MP3 file.

scenes.title: Success — waveforms and quality metrics
scenes.screenshotContent: File saved checkmark, Play/Pause/Stop, Save stego file, Verify roundtrip, dual waveform comparison (cover vs stego), metrics: SNR 47.34 dB, PSNR 96.36 dB, BER 0.0000%.
scenes.veoPrompt: Animate provided embed-result screenshot. Green checkmark pulse on File saved. Dual waveforms draw left-to-right — teal original cover overlay and dark stego trace. Metric chips fade in sequentially: Duration, Bits embedded, SNR, PSNR, BER. Subtle glow on SNR and PSNR values. Floating phone on dark reflective surface. Futuristic clean data viz, 16:9 tech demo 2026.
scenes.voiceover: See proof in the waveforms — high SNR, high PSNR, zero bit error.
scenes.sfx: Data processing hum, waveform ping, success tone

scenes.title: Extract — pick stego audio
scenes.screenshotContent: Extract tab selected: Pick audio file WAV/MP3 button, disabled Extract button with lock icon.
scenes.veoPrompt: Image-to-video from Extract tab screenshot. Teal Pick audio file button receives tap ripple, folder icon bounce. Extract button unlock animation — padlock opens and button gains teal glow. Magnifying glass nav tab highlighted. Clean minimal UI, light background. Phone mockup slow orbit 5 degrees. 16:9 product walkthrough 2026.
scenes.voiceover: Open your stego file and enter the message length in bits to extract.

scenes.title: Critical — save bit length
scenes.screenshotContent: Full guide bottom sheet: what app does (local processing), app tabs, Embed steps — message box and audio source, chaos params must match.
scenes.veoPrompt: Focus on provided Full guide modal screenshot over dimmed app background. Scroll highlight on Embed steps section — pulse on message-length-in-bits instruction. Soft amber warning ring then teal confirm glow on step text about matching chaos parameters. Emphasize importance without clutter. Modern bottom-sheet UI on phone mockup. 16:9.
scenes.voiceover: Always save the message length in bits — and use the same chaos key to recover.

scenes.title: Settings — chaos key and on-device privacy
scenes.screenshotContent: Settings: English selected, teal theme color, logistic chaos preview graph, r=3.990 slider, x0=0.45 slider, message length limit.
scenes.veoPrompt: Show provided Settings screenshot. Chaos sequence preview graph animates — teal waveform redraws. r parameter slider moves slightly, x0 slider adjusts. Theme color swatches cycle then settle on teal. Shield overlay animation suggesting 100% on-device — no cloud upload, crossed cloud icon briefly. Language chips highlight EN. Modern 2026 security app aesthetic. 16:9.
scenes.voiceover: Tune r and x0, pick your theme — everything runs locally on your device.
scenes.sfx: Toggle click, soft shield shimmer, slider tick

scenes.title: Multilingual — four languages
scenes.screenshotContent: Language screen: Persian, English, Arabic, French cards with LTR/RTL direction icons.
scenes.veoPrompt: Image-to-video from language picker screenshot on floating phone. Dark teal theme. Each language card highlights in sequence — Persian, English, Arabic, French — with subtle RTL/LTR arrow icon pulse. Translation icon at top gentle glow. Premium global app feel. Keep native script labels sharp. 16:9 cinematic.
scenes.voiceover: Persian, English, Arabic, and French — with light and dark themes.

scenes.title: Outro — thesis, NTK, and download
scenes.screenshotContent: About us: Alireza Karavi, thesis title logistic chaos mapping, v1.2.6, Dr. Mehdi Mosleh supervisor, GitHub and NTK links.
scenes.veoPrompt: Cinematic outro from About us screenshot. Slow Ken Burns on developer profile and thesis title. GitHub and NTK link rows subtle highlight sweep. Version 1.2.6 badge teal glow. Fade to minimal end card overlay space for Myket URL and xwav.ir text placeholders. Teal particle field settles. Professional research app closing 2026. 16:9.
scenes.voiceover: Audio Steganography — NTK thesis research. Download on Myket. Details at xwav.ir.
scenes.sfx: Soft outro fade, upbeat CTA rise at end

voiceoverFull: Your message hides inside the sound wave. Audio Steganography — hide text in audio with LSB and a logistic chaos key. Type your text, record or upload audio. See proof in the waveforms — high SNR, high PSNR, zero bit error. Open your stego file and enter the message length in bits. Always save the bit length and use the same chaos key. Tune r and x0 — everything runs on your device. Persian, English, Arabic, and French. Download on Myket. NTK thesis research at xwav.ir.

musicDirection.reference: 2026 tech product launch — not dated corporate

assemblyInstructions.order: Render scenes 1 through 9 sequentially using Gemini Create Video image-to-video mode.
perSceneWorkflow: Upload referenceImagePath as the starting frame (portrait 1080×1920 inside phone mockup).
Paste veoPrompt into the prompt field.
Use voiceover text for English TTS or record separately.
Download each clip as s01-splash.mp4 through s09-about-outro.mp4.
postProduction: Stitch clips in sceneNumber order (CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or Premiere).
End card 2 seconds: Myket URL https://myket.ir/app/ir.ntk.audiowmark.app plus xwav.ir/en/ (no Myket banner in screenshot set).
Export H.264 1080p 16:9 for Myket listing and xwav.ir embed.

geminiStudioQuickPaste.singleCombinedPromptForManualMode: Create a 54-second modern 2026 promotional video for Audio Steganography Android app (ir.ntk.audiowmark.app). Use 9 clips of 6 seconds each. Image-to-video from real app screenshots in SocialMediaContent/screenshotsReal/screenshots/en (1.jpg splash, 4.png quick guide, 5.png embed recording, 6.png metrics, 7.png extract, 8.png full guide, 10.png settings, 2.jpg languages, 9.png about). Style: premium teal tech, floating portrait phone in 16:9 frame, smooth Ken Burns. Story: hide text in audio, LSB logistic chaos key, record embed, SNR/PSNR proof, extract with bit length, on-device settings, four languages, thesis outro Myket CTA. English voiceover from scenes[].voiceover.
